reviews.text: The masks are soothing, hydrating, and leave my skin feeling soft and refreshed after each use. I love that there’s a mask for different skincare needs throughout the week, making it easy to add a little extra care to my routine. The masks fit well, feel comfortable on the skin, and don’t leave a heavy or sticky residue. My skin looks more plump, smooth, and glowy after using them. Definitely a great set for anyone who loves a simple weekly self-care routine!
reviews.zh: 呢啲面膜好舒緩、補水，用完令我皮膚感覺柔軟、清新。我鍾意每星期有唔同嘅面膜，應付唔同嘅護膚需要，令我輕鬆喺護膚中加多啲護理。面膜貼得好服帖，戴落舒服，唔會留低厚重或黏手嘅殘留。用完我皮膚睇起嚟更飽滿、順滑、有光澤。對於鍾意簡單每週自我護理嘅人，呢套真係好好！

reviews.text:
mixsoon - Daily Mask Weekly Care Set

This set is perfect for anyone who loves structured skincare routines. The masks are thin, lightweight, and adhere beautifully to the skin without slipping. Each variant targets a specific concern (soothing, brightening, hydrating), making it easy to customize your week.

Pros:

Lightweight essence, not sticky

Great daily-use option

Leaves skin plump and calm

Cons:

Results are more maintenance-focused than transformative

Overall: A reliable, gentle weekly reset for balanced, hydrated skin.
